== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Life [[madra]] is one of the seven primary [[aspects of madra]], alongside fire, earth, [[wind]], [[water]], force, and [[blood]]. It is characterized by its liquid state; even in the form of [[Remnants]], it appears as gelatinous masses or oozes. This aspect is fundamentally linked to the concept of vitality, as it can be used to accelerate natural healing processes and smooth over injuries such as burns. In combat or specialized applications, life [[madra]] can manifest as physical [[constructs]] like lashing roots, vines, or even large trees and blooming branches. While it can be used as a perception [[technique]] to pinpoint targets, it is also capable of being used offensively, such as through lances or beams of energy. Practitioners may utilize sacred instruments to channel this power. Furthermore, life [[madra]] is a component in the creation of certain [[elixirs]] and can be processed by specialized engines to sustain combat capabilities.}}
